name: Chatislav
author: Chatislav.ai

sections.description:
Chatislav is an advanced plugin that allows you to integrate intelligent conversational agents into your WordPress website. Enhance your customer experience with AI-powered chat functionality.

For more information about privacy and terms of service, refer to our dedicated sections: Privacy Policy and Terms of Service.
sections.installation:
1. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress
  2. Use the Settings->Chatislav screen to configure the plugin
  3. Add your AI Agent token from your Chatislav dashboard
sections.faq:
How do I get an AI agent token?

You can get your token from the Chatislav dashboard at https://chatislav.ai

How to initialize my agent?

  1. Install this plugin to your WordPress website.
  2. Copy your Agent token from Chatislav deploy page.
  3. Navigate to “Chatislav” tab under the “Settings” menu in the sidebar of your WordPress dashboard.
  4. Paste your Agent token into the designated field.
  5. Click “Save”

Can I display the chatbot on specific pages only?

Yes, you can configure the plugin to show on all pages or only on specific pages of your choice.
